submission.justification: Geant4 simulations at the maximum allowed coverage (30%, 100k events each) give D3 = 52.8 PE/MeV, D1 = 37.5, D2 = 25.6. These match the 2025 summary scaled by coverage^0.8 from 20%. Light collection rises with coverage, and the feedthroughs support up to 30%, so 30% is optimal. D3 gives about 41% more light than D1. CAVEAT: none of the project documents covers mechanical or cryogenic robustness for any design. D3's thin bonded dichroic filter is a plausible risk because of delamination or cracking from thermal-contraction mismatch during cooldown to LAr temperature, and modules cannot be reached after fill. This recommendation depends on D3 passing repeated thermal-cycling and long-term LAr immersion tests before the Q3 design freeze. If it fails, fall back to Module-D1 at 30% coverage (37.5 PE/MeV).

requirements.evidence: Simulated at 30%: D3 52.8, D1 37.5, D2 25.6 PE/MeV. D3 at the maximum coverage is highest, and light rises monotonically with coverage (~coverage^0.8).
